<!-- pr-reviewer: f441d38babb3596b9cd2d57f13a9943c513493e6 -->
**Needs changes before merge.** One code conflict with main is blocking; the rest is verified green.

Thanks @mkinney for the 770MX proof. The tool-number model is clear, and the undo and project-file paths follow the command law.

### What looks good
- `SetToolNumber` (`crates/app/src/commands/tool_number.rs`) is a real undoable command: `invert` restores the previous number, and it refuses by name (not a tool, out of range, taken by another tool, no-op).
- `ChangeTool`, `DeleteTool` and `DeleteEntity` keep the number on apply, undo and delete, so no undo loses it.
- The UI goes through `CommandKind::SetToolNumber` and the history (`crates/ui/src/state.rs`, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs`), so nothing writes the number ad hoc.
- The post refuses two tools posting one number, naming both (`crates/app/src/tool_numbers.rs` `clash`, called from `crates/app/src/posting.rs` before any record is built). Unnumbered documents post as before.
- The project field is additive (`number` on the tool record, written only when set), and a stated number outside 1-99999 is refused on load by name (`crates/app/src/project/validate.rs`).

### Local results
**Blocking: the trial merge with main conflicts in code.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mod.rs` lines 105-109 has both `mod tool_number_tests;` (this PR) and `mod gate_route_tests;` (main) at the same spot. Per the review rules I did not merge; I reviewed the PR head (`f441d38`, based on c9a9fb3) and built it as is. The fix is to keep both lines.

Head results, unmerged:

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | built, exit 0 |
| app `tool_numbers` | 6 passed |
| app `project_roundtrip` | 68 passed |
| app `tool_list` / `tool_after_state` / `tool_gate` / `tool_law` | 6 / 5 / 9 / 4 passed |
| app `operations` | 117 passed, 6 ignored |
| app `posting` / `conformance` / `float_roundtrip` | 17 / 6 / 2 passed |
| `camcraft-ui --lib` | 240 passed, 2 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | exit 0 |

No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic` is added in app source.

### Requested before merge
1. Resolve the `mod` conflict in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mod.rs` (lines 105-109) by keeping both `mod tool_number_tests;` and `mod gate_route_tests;` (the tree is otherwise clean against main).

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
1. Message nit: `crates/app/src/commands/tool_number.rs:45` prints `already 'EM-0400''s`, with a doubled apostrophe. Suggested: `"tool number {n} is already {other}'s"` or `"...already held by '{other}'"`.
2. The clash rule runs at post time, not at `SetToolNumber` creation. An explicit number that collides with another tool's list position is only refused when the program uses both tools. That is documented and acceptable, but a warning in the editor would help.
3. `feat:` commit: merges at the next minor cut, per the release train. The `egui_tool_editor.png` snapshot change is explained in the PR text.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
